PB-1_human_can_alter_executor_during_exe.reading: Human holds the executor's workspace credentials or can revise its contract/context while Stages 5-6 run (not reported; p.9 manual context transfer, p.30 no explicit identity/authorization mechanism)

PB-2_only_independent_pre_stage_manifest.reading: Human's only influence is the Stage-4 authorization, treated as an independently issued pre-stage manifest (DEA p.8: does not establish control)

PB-3_post_seal_context_injection_before_.reading: Human relays context to the agent only after the execution evidence is persisted (Stage 6), before Stage 7; object = execution output x

PB-3v_same_reading_object_is_verificatio.reading: As PB-3, but the object judged is the Stage-7 verification report produced by the same agent

PB-4_planner_relay_via_human_during_exec.reading: Planner output copied unchecked into the executor's instructions during execution (Fig. 8, p.29), modelled as an unmediated planner->executor criteria edge; the planner has no control edge to the acceptor

_note: A positive witness is reported as CONFLICT even when the record is incomplete (v0.3.5 p.11: a recorded witness yields CONFLICT). PB-2 'hypothetical_complete' additionally assumes the record start t0 covers the Stage-4 authorization (v0.3.5 O2, p.38, lookback open).
